intro: Second Timothy is Paul's last letter, written from a Roman prison, knowing his death was near.
Chapters one and two urge Timothy to be strong, unashamed, and faithful. Chapters three and four warn of hard times, and point to the Scriptures, ending with Paul's farewell.
Paul wrote it to Timothy, whom he called his dearly beloved son.
Listen for his last words: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith.

card.parts: Ch. 1–2: be strong | Ch. 3–4: hold to Scripture; farewell
card.key: Not the spirit of fear (1) · All scripture (3) · I have kept the faith (4)
